analysis.reasonEn: RSI moved from oversold (33.6) to 44.0, still in neutral territory. MACD histogram improved from -20.5605 to -13.7717, but ADX at 20.5 indicates an early trend formation stage with no clear direction. A Lower High pattern is forming as the 5-day high is below the 20-day high, signaling weakness. Current price ($1635.57) is above SMA200 ($1589.17) but below SMA20 ($1713.35), suggesting a lack of direction. Therefore, a wait-and-see approach is warranted pending further indicator confirmation.
